h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruvottiyur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tiruvottiyur

c: Tiruvottiyur lies on the sea front in north Chennai, close to the port and the industrial belt, and its air carries both salt and industrial dust. That combination is hard on outdoor metal. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tiruvottiyur for parks and playgrounds maintained by the Greater Chennai Corporation, schools, colleges, industrial staff quarters and residential associations. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,050 km away.

Chennai's heavy rain comes with the northeast monsoon, from October to December, and low-lying parts of north Chennai flood easily. We plan for both the salt and the water. You share photos and the size of the space, we suggest machines and send a layout drawing, and our team or a dealer in south India installs once you approve. Industrial staff quarters in the area can also take a small set near the residential blocks.

richText.heading: Sea air, monsoon floods and a long equipment life

c: Choose galvanised frames and moulded parts, and keep the gym a little back from the beach road if you can. Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks to remove salt and dust. Raise the base and drain it so water clears quickly after the October rains.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines last longest near the sea?
items.a: Galvanised machines with few moving parts, such as parallel bars and pull-up stations. All machines last longer with regular fresh-water rinsing to remove salt.

items.q: Can you supply industrial staff quarters in north Chennai?
items.a: Yes. Share the open space available and the expected users. We will suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing and quote.

items.q: What should we do after a cyclone or heavy storm?
items.a: Check that all bolts are tight and no frame has shifted. If anything looks loose or damaged, contact our after-sales team before the machines are used again.
